title: Nintendo celebrates 40 years of Zelda with Ocarina of Time remake, Switch 2 special edition, and live-action movie
summary: The company announces the Ocarina of Time remake for Switch 2, a commemorative console, concert tour, and a movie titled simply The Legend of Zelda.

title: Persona 6 and Kingdom Hearts IV achievements leaked on Steam while Atlus hints at Persona 3 and 4 remakes
summary: A massive leak reveals achievements for Persona 6 and Kingdom Hearts IV, and Atlus hints that Persona 3 Reload and Persona 4 Revival could be their next projects.

title: The Tetris Company demands removal of Tetris clone from White House website over copyright infringement
summary: Following a legal warning, the Tetris clone hosted on the White House virtual arcade is removed for violating copyright.

title: Don't Nod, studio behind Life is Strange, on brink of closure and plans mass layoffs to survive
summary: The French developer warns it could run out of cash by January 2027 and is negotiating workforce reductions of up to 90 positions.

title: FuturLab lays off staff and cancels unannounced project following PowerWash Simulator success
summary: The studio acknowledges layoffs and the cancellation of an unrevealed game, while attempting to soften the impact by referring to those affected as 'The Leavers'.

title: Final hearing begins in Rockstar legal battle against former GTA 6 employees with union rally
summary: Rockstar faces a lawsuit over layoffs during GTA 6 development, and the final hearing kicks off with a rally in support of workers.

title: Capcom revives dormant franchises: Onimusha: Way of the Sword and possible new Devil May Cry and Okami
summary: Following the Onimusha announcement, Capcom confirms plans to revive classic IPs like Devil May Cry 6 and Okami, according to recent statements.

title: Xbox program to digitize physical discs stumbles: several major publishers not participating
summary: Xbox's 'Disc-to-Digital' feature allows converting physical games to digital, but publishers like EA, Ubisoft, and Take-Two have not joined.

title: GOG attempts to revive physical format with nostalgic editions while Sony abandons it
summary: GOG launches an initiative to preserve games in physical format with large boxes and extras, contrasting with Sony's digital strategy.

title: September 2026 Nintendo Direct: date, time, and what to expect from the event
summary: Nintendo schedules a new Direct for September 2026 with possible game announcements for Switch 2 and updates for current titles.

title: Macron announces international video game festival in France following success of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
summary: The French president declares video games part of national culture and creates an international festival to boost the French industry.

title: The Blood of Dawnwalker already preparing sequel days after launch and faces criticism over difficulty
summary: Studio Rebel Wolves begins work on sequel to its vampire RPG, while players debate the harshness of its mechanics.

title: Bethesda prioritized Starfield over The Elder Scrolls 6 due to sudden decision, according to studio veterans
summary: Former developers reveal that management imposed Starfield as the main project, shelving the long-awaited Skyrim sequel without prior consultation.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra to remake existing games and European developers fear AI pressure
summary: The new AI allows recreating games but with worse results, while an EU report shows creators fear more demanding work rhythms, not their replacement.

title: NBA 2K27 debuts DLSS 5 with notable visual improvements, but demands high-end graphics cards
summary: The game implements Nvidia's new upscaling technology offering more realistic basketball, though optimal performance requires powerful GPUs.

title: Street Fighter 6 introduces Arjun, new Indian fighter, and confirms October 2026 release
summary: Capcom showcases Arjun's gameplay, a Bollywood-loving boxer, and details the downloadable content schedule for the game.
